summary: Defines an UNSELECT command for IMAP4 that closes the current mailbox without expunging it. Some clients need to release resources tied to the selected mailbox without selecting another one, which IMAP4 previously did only through awkward workarounds. It is a proposed standard.

eli5.summary: Closing a folder normally might also throw out messages marked for deletion. This adds a way to just close it and leave everything as it was.

questions: how to close an imap mailbox without expunge
